card.name: Adjective before 'means' or 'route'
card.fires_on: The word or word part that follows 'by' and comes right before 'means', 'routes' or 'mechanisms', such as 'legal', 'other', or the middle of 'intramuscular'.

modes.label: Other/legal means
modes.description: A modifier after 'by' or 'through' that is followed by 'means' or 'laws'.
modes.example: he would have to take control of Germany by<< legal>> means, not through revolution.

modes.label: Administration route
modes.description: The end of a route word like intramuscular or intrathecal after 'by', just before 'route'.
modes.example: The total dose administered by the intramus<<cular>> route should not exceed 150

modes.label: Pharmacokinetic mechanisms
modes.example: may interact with warfarin sodium through pharmacodynamic or pharmacokin<<etic>> mechanisms.

card.writes: It pushes the model to say 'means' or 'route'-type words (手段, 途径, means) next.
card.plain: It fires after 'by' plus a describing word, when the next word will be 'means' or 'route'.
